name: San Esteban del Valle (Spain)
description: Square flag divided horizontally red over white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Esteban del Valle (a saint on white above a tree on yellow).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 30 October 2000 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 29 of 9 February 2001); the flag is defined as a square flag of proportion 1:1, red and white per horizontal half, with the municipal arms in its colours at the centre.

features.role: San Esteban del Valle arms — saint above a tree
